description: A shell script for testing git svn globbing refspecs, involving SVN and Git commands, directory setup, and test assertions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs a series of commands, and verifies outcomes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used for testing error conditions.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file or output.
